title: Esrbespoke header
description: A transparent bar over the top of the page on the 12-column grid: the company name, a tagline at column 4, a stacked list of tiny capital links at column 9 (the current page marked by a small square that also scales in on hover) and a two-line menu icon. Two small dark chips (CONTACT and the menu) stay fixed at the top right: on phones always, on desktop they fade in after the first half screen; they lift away when the footer arrives. The menu opens a black full-screen list of the same links.
notes: it scrolls away with the page (absolute); place it first, above a hero
tone="dark" for a dark hero (white text), tone="light" on paper
the chip fade-in and lift-away are CSS scroll-driven (scroll(root)); without support the chips are simply shown
needs JavaScript for the menu (hydrate: load)
name: esrbespoke-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the company name, top left on desktop

props.name: mark
props.description: the short wordmark shown top left on phones (set plainly in the label face, wide and bold)

props.name: tagline
props.description: a short line at column 4 on desktop

props.name: links
props.description: the page links, stacked at column 9

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: accessible names for the menu button and the close button

props.name: tone
props.description: what the bar sits on: "dark" for a dark hero (white text), "light"/"charcoal" otherwise
